## Setting
Choosing where the group travels. Five friends take one trip together each year and have reached the point where the destination must be fixed. Everyone is going regardless of which is chosen. Participants: Midori, Jonathan, Minato, Shizue and Mizuki. Each participant has a concern of their own, which the others do not know.
Things that can be looked into (titles only):
- Pricing of offshore houses let whole
- Valley inn rates versus urban beds
- Ferry sailings and train time
- Getting around by train and bus
- Bathing hours and bathroom provision
- Inn mealtimes and room arrangements
- All-in rates against meals bought separately
- What separately booked rooms cost last time
- Time alone in the shared-house year
- How last year's days ran

The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Mizuki, Shizue, Minato, Jonathan and Midori. |---|---|---|---|

| 2 | each participant is told what they found out (that participant only) | 4 turns | nothing |

Name: Midori
Age: 38
Gender: female
Personality: Midori has a calm and kind personality. She is friendly to everyone and listens to the concerns and problems of those around her, offering reliable advice. She can be a little shy, often acting reserved with people she meets for the first time, but once she opens up, she shows her bright and energetic side. Name: Jonathan
Age: 38
Gender: male
Personality: Jonathan has a calm and introverted personality and values inner peace. He prefers spending quiet time alone rather than forming deep connections with others. Name: Minato
Age: 10
Gender: male
Personality: Minato has a calm personality and likes to interact with people around him in a peaceful manner. Concern: I sleep badly away from home, and it is the small things that decide how a week goes: where I wash, when I have to be at the table, whether there is anywhere to sit that is not a bed. By the middle of last year's trip I was counting the days.

Name: Shizue
Age: 78
Gender: female
Personality: Shizue has a very calm and gentle personality. Even as she has grown older, she continues to smile warmly at those around her and is a very caring person. She is always considerate of others, friendly, and sometimes shows a playful side. She often reaches out to those who are feeling down with kind words and never hesitates to lend a helping hand when needed, which has earned her the affection of many people in the village and community. Through her years of life experience, Shizue has come to understand the importance of living peacefully with others.
Concern: We have never had a rule for who pays for what, so it holds until it doesn't and somebody quietly ends up out of pocket. I would rather the money fell out of the arrangement itself than out of who happened to be organised that month.

Name: Mizuki
Age: 24
Gender: female
Personality: Mizuki is a very confident woman who is often relied upon by those around her. She is calm and logical in her thinking and is good at observing people. As a result, she always makes calm judgments and chooses her actions according to the situation around her. Although she may sometimes come across as a little aloof, she is actually very caring and cannot ignore those who are weak. While she is relied upon by those around her and occasionally asserts her opinions strongly, she also possesses a kindness that considers others.
Concern: The point of these weeks is the five of us together, yet the last few have left me feeling either crowded or oddly alone, and never for a reason I could name at the time. Before we book anything I would like to understand what actually produces that.

## Hidden information
The options and the full text of every card are listed here. The participants do not know them before the schedule above says so, and nothing from them may appear in the talk before the round in which it is revealed.

Options (see the schedule above):
- A: Hot Spring Town. A stay at an inn in a spa town reachable by train, with meals taken at the inn and the days left unplanned.
- B: Island Trip. A stay on an offshore island reached by ferry, with the group in one rented house and transport on the island arranged as a group.
- C: City Break. Several nights in a large city with separate accommodation and a loose plan, leaving each person to arrange their own daytime routes.

Cards (see the schedule above; title: text):
- Pricing of offshore houses let whole: Houses out on the islands let by the building rather than the head: the ones that were priced come to about 5,400 yen a head a night, with food on top.
- Valley inn rates versus urban beds: Inn rates in that valley sit near 17,000 yen a head with dinner and breakfast folded in; a city bed alone runs 12,000 to 20,000, and meals come after that.
- Ferry sailings and train time: The ferry sails three times a day and the last one back leaves at 16:20, so two days go to travelling; the train up to the spa valley takes ninety minutes.
- Getting around by train and bus: A city runs on trains every few minutes, so nobody has to plan ahead to move; the bus out of the spa valley goes hourly and stops before seven in the evening.
- Bathing hours and bathroom provision: Inn baths open from before six in the morning until midnight; the island houses examined list one bathroom for the whole building, and reviews mention the water running cold.
- Inn mealtimes and room arrangements: Dinner at those inns is served at six and breakfast at half seven, with everyone on futons in one room; a city room has a door and no timetable.
- All-in rates against meals bought separately: An all-in per-head rate charges the light eater exactly what the biggest appetite pays, whereas meals bought on the day are settled at whatever each person actually orders.
- What separately booked rooms cost last time: Rooms booked one at a time for the same nights differed by nearly 8,000 yen across the group last trip, while a building rented whole arrives as one bill that divides evenly.
- Time alone in the shared-house year: The year the group took a house together, whoever wanted an hour by themselves had nowhere to take it; a town with streets, shops and a public bath absorbs that easily.
- How last year's days ran: Last year the days ran separately and two of the group went from breakfast to dinner without meeting; a party that moves together shares the day whether it plans to or not.
